challenges.challangesIntro: To empower young adults with Down Syndrome and intellectual disabilities to live moreindependently and participate fully in society

objectives.objintro: To enhance access to learning, skill development and career guidance opportunities for young adults with Down Syndrome and intellectual disabilities.
To promote social inclusion and equal participation of young adults with Down Syndrome and intellectual disabilities in recreational and social activities.
To provide specialized healthcare services and therapies to address the specific needs of young adults with Down Syndrome and intellectual disabilities.
To offer support and guidance to parents and caregivers of young adults with Down Syndrome and intellectual disabilities.
To raise awareness and advocate for the rights of young adults with Down Syndrome and intellectual disabilities in the broader community.
